description: This file contains utility functions and types for managing SSH sandbox sessions, including creation, disposal, command execution, and directory upload, primarily used within the openclaw project for handling SSH-based sandboxing.

methods.name: function normalizeInlineSshMaterial(contents: string, filename: string): string { normalizeInlineSshMaterial
methods.description: Normalizes SSH key and certificate contents by removing BOM, normalizing newlines, and expanding escaped sequences based on filename type.

methods.name: function buildSshFailureMessage(stderr: string, exitCode?: number): string { buildSshFailureMessage
methods.description: Constructs an error message based on SSH stderr output and exit code, indicating specific failure reasons like libcrypto errors or permission issues.

methods.name: export function shellEscape(value: string): string { shellEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe use in shell commands by wrapping in single quotes and escaping inner quotes.

methods.name: buildRemoteCommand
methods.description: Constructs a remote shell command string by shell-escaping each argument.

methods.name: buildExecRemoteCommand
methods.description: Builds a full command string for executing a command remotely with optional working directory and environment variables.

methods.name: buildSshSandboxArgv
methods.description: Creates the argument vector for initiating an SSH sandbox session based on session details and TTY option.

methods.name: createSshSandboxSessionFromConfigText
methods.description: Creates an SSH sandbox session from a given SSH config text, optionally specifying host and command, and writes temporary config files.

methods.name: createSshSandboxSessionFromSettings
methods.description: Creates an SSH sandbox session from provided settings, including handling private keys, certificates, and known hosts data, and writes configuration to temporary files.

methods.name: disposeSshSandboxSession
methods.description: Deletes the temporary configuration directory associated with a sandbox session.

methods.name: runSshSandboxCommand
methods.description: Executes a command over SSH sandbox, capturing output, handling process events, and errors.

methods.name: uploadDirectoryToSshTarget
methods.description: Uploads a local directory to the SSH target, ensuring safe symlink handling and stream processing.

methods.name: assertSafeUploadSymlinks
methods.description: Recursive helper that verifies symlinks do not escape the designated upload directory.

methods.name: parseSshConfigHost
methods.description: Parses the SSH config text to extract the host alias.

methods.name: resolveSshTmpRoot
methods.description: Resolves the temporary root directory for SSH sandbox files.

methods.name: resolveOptionalLocalPath
methods.description: Resolves a local path string, expanding user directories if provided.

methods.name: writeSecretMaterial
methods.description: Writes SSH key or cert material to a file with proper permissions and normalization.
